video_list.caption: How to write a research paper like a phd/master student!!! #research #phd #literaturereview #citation #researchpaper
video_list.transcript: How to write your thesis paper like a PhD/Master student. Just go to this website. Click researcher. Type your research paper topic. Pro tip: use latex for PDFs. Then watch it do its magic in 2-3 mins. It is done. A complete research paper with meaningful visualizations.
video_list.frames_summary: Handheld laptop screen begins on Google Scholar. Large white subtitle says how to write a thesis paper like a PhD/Master student. The video jumps to a research assistant website, clicks researcher, types a research topic, selects Latex/PDF, waits 2-3 minutes, then shows a complete paper and visualizations.

analysis_goal: 提炼可复用的产品营销视频结构，重点模仿 Google Scholar 学术信任封面、PhD/Master 身份钩子和工具演示节奏。
